query:
WITH latest_year AS (
  SELECT MAX(YEAR(birth_date)) AS max_year 
  FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala 
  WHERE birth_date IS NOT NULL 
    AND birth_date > '1900-01-01'
    AND (person_status = 'صالح' OR death_date IS NULL)
),
total_births AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS total_count 
  FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala 
  WHERE YEAR(birth_date) = (SELECT max_year FROM latest_year)
    AND birth_date IS NOT NULL 
    AND birth_date > '1900-01-01'
    AND (person_status = 'صالح' OR death_date IS NULL)
),
resident_births AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS resident_count 
  FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala 
  WHERE YEAR(birth_date) = (SELECT max_year FROM latest_year)
    AND person_type = 'Alien'
    AND birth_date IS NOT NULL 
    AND birth_date > '1900-01-01'
    AND (person_status = 'صالح' OR death_date IS NULL)
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT max_year FROM latest_year) AS year,
  (SELECT total_count FROM total_births) AS total_births,
  (SELECT resident_count FROM resident_births) AS resident_births,
  ROUND((SELECT resident_count FROM resident_births) * 100.0 / (SELECT total_count FROM total_births), 2) AS resident_percentage
